question: Select the **INCORRECTLY** spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Consenses'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is** 'Consensus'**.(सामंजस्य)
 
• The word** "consensus" **refers to a general agreement or opinion reached by a group of people.
 
• It represents a collective decision or understanding. The correct spelling of the word is** "consensus,**" not **"consenses."**

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Consenses'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Confession:** It refers to an admission or acknowledgment of a wrongdoing or a disclosure of personal thoughts, feelings, or experiences.(पश्चाताप)
 
• **Battalion:** It refers to a large organized group of soldiers, typically consisting of several companies.(सेना का बड़ा वाहिनी खंड)
 
• **Battery**: It can have multiple meanings, but commonly it refers to a device that produces and stores electrical energy or a unit of artillery.(बैटरी)
